name: download
description: Download a file so you receive it as an attachment, up to 25 MB. Google Docs, Sheets, Slides and Drawings are exported to format: Docs to pdf, docx, odt, md, txt, html, rtf or epub; Sheets to xlsx, ods, pdf, csv or tsv; Slides to pdf, pptx, odp or txt; Drawings to png, pdf, jpg or svg.

format.description: Export format for Google files. Default: pdf for Docs and Slides, xlsx for Sheets.
